p1.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/resorts-world-new-york-city-local-impact-siting-mitigating-potential-impacts-communities-local-0
p1.excerpt: The new partnership will begin investing in new housing developments in the immediate term. This landmark agreement with Cirrus, labor pension funds, and contractors will ensure there is affordable housing financed by, built by, and lived in by working- and middle-class families.

p2.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/02/exhibit-174-rwnyc-cirrus-mou_redacted.pdf
p2.excerpt: WHEREAS, the Parties desire to amplify both the actual and perceived scale and results of the RWNYC Impact Goals (the “Multiplier Effect”) and ultimate WFH creation via leveraging CWFHA’s WFH Investment pipeline, the CWFHA Coalition and CWFHA’s WFH investment expertise, and as such the Parties desire to enter into a long-term strategic joint venture (the “RCJV”) to:

p3.title: https://rwnewyork.com/rws-next-chapter/resorts-world-new-york-city-cirrus-unveil-new-agreement-to-build-up-to-50000-units-of-workforce-housing/
p3.excerpt: Resorts World New York City has officially formed a joint venture with Cirrus to invest in this housing commitment, which will focus on large-scale projects across the five boroughs. The new partnership will begin to invest in new housing developments in the immediate term.

p4.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/02/exhibit-175-rwnyc-cirrus-partnership-agreement_redacted.pdf
p4.excerpt: “Investments” means (i) co-investments by the Partnership with other investment vehicles and partnerships managed by the Management Company in the development and ownership of workforce housing in New York City and its suburbs (“Co-Investments”); (ii) investments by the Partnership alongside other Management Company anchor investors within the Management Company’s flagship funds in order to support further investments by these vehicles in the development and ownership of workforce housing in New York City and its suburbs

p5.title: https://rwnewyork.com/community/community-investments/workforce-housing/
p5.excerpt: Resorts World's Workforce Housing Initiative, funded through the Cirrus Workforce Housing Fund, is a landmark partnership with organized labor to deliver tens of thousands of new homes for working families across New York City.
